question: The queue item for this unit names HERE, LocationIQ and Stadia Maps as missing from the corpus; should that part of the item be closed, since data-apis/here, data-apis/locationiq and data-apis/stadia-maps now exist?
why: No draft was written for the three. A third-party figure of 250,000 HERE transactions a month does not match data-apis/here (30,000 Geocode and Reverse Geocode transactions a month on the Base plan, with a payment method on file); whether 250,000 was the quota of the retired no-card Limited plan is unverified, because no page read in this unit states it. The LocationIQ figure of 5,000 requests a day and the Stadia Maps figure of 200,000 credits a month match their records.
